violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CFM ONSITE AT BEGINNING OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE A CFM IS ONSITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.' PIC WAS UNABLE TO PROVIDE EHS WITH SIGNED COPIES OF THE EMPLOYEE HEALTH POLICY.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. EHS SENT THE PIC COPIES OF THE AGREEMENT. PLEASE ENSURE SIGNED COPIES ARE KEPT ONSITE AT THE ESTABLISHMENT.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS SENT THE PIC A COPY OF THE CLEANUP PROCEDURE. PLEASE KEEP A COPY OF THE PROCEDURE ONSITE.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at COOK-LINE AND FRONT SERVICE AREA handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC ADDED TOWELS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE HANDWASHING SINKS ARE ALWAYS PROPERLY SUPPLIED.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at handwashing sink AT THE COOK-LINE used by food employees.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. EHS WILL SEND PIC A COPY OF SIGNAGE THAT MAY BE POSTED.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED RAWA EGGS STORED OVER PRODUCE IN THE LEFT 2-DOOR PREP-TOP; OBSERVED RAW DUCK STORED OVER MIXED GREENS IN THE TWO-DOOR UPRIGHT COOLER; OBSERVED RAW FISH AND EGGS STORED OVER PRODUCE IN THE WALK-IN COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC REORGANIZED COOLERS DURING INSPECTION. EHS PROVIDED GUIDANCE AGAIN. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED FRIED ONIONS IN OIL MADE AT THE ESTABLISHMENT (MADE MORE THAN 4 HOURS PRIOR TO TAKING THE TEMPERATURE).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED THE ONIONS DURING THE INSPECTION. EHS PROVIDED OPTIONS FOR FRIED ONIONS IN THE FUTURE. PLEASE EITHER KEPP ONIONS UNDER TEMPERATURE/TIME CONTROL OR PURCHASE COMMERCIAL FRIED ONIONS. PETER CHANG HERNDON (Inspection Date: 09/17/2026) Page 2 of 4

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: OBSERVED FOOD ITEMS IN CONTAINERS STORED ON THE FLOOR OF THE WALK-IN FREEZER AND IN THE BAR AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PLEASE ELEVATE THESE FOOD ITEMS PRIOR TO YOUR NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: OBSERVED THREE KNIVES STORED BETWEEN PREP-TOPS AND TABLES IN THE BACK KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EHS DISCUSSED PROPER UTENSIL STORAGE WITH THE PIC AGAIN. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION.

violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC UNDERSTANDS HANDWASHING SINKS SHOULD BE USED FOR HANDWASHING ONLY.

Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC MOVED DUCKS DURING INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS RAW ANIMAL PROTEINS HOULD NOT BE STORED ABOVE ANY READY-TO EAT FOODS LIKE PRODUCE/SAUCES. violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: OBSERVED A LARGE PORTION OF COOLING FRIED CHICKEN ON PLASTIC-WRAPPED SHEET PAN IN A SPEED-RACK AT 90-117F, MADE APPROXIMATELY AN HOUR BEFORE.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. PIC MOVED CHICKEN TO WALK-IN COOLER AND UNDERSTANDS COOLING FOODS SHOULD NOT BE TIGHTLY WRAPPED PRIOR TO MEETING COOLING PARAMETERS, AND SHOULD BE IN A SINGLE/SMALL LAYER ON SHEET PAN TO ALLOW FOR PROPER COOLING. PIC MOVED CHICKEN TO WALK-IN COOLER DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. PLEASE ENSURE A FOOD THERMOMETER IS OBTAINED PRIOR TO FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION. PETER CHANG HERNDON (Inspection Date: 04/23/2025) Page 3 of 5

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: OBSERVED VARIOUS CONTAINERS/BOTTLES OF FOOD ITEMS (NOT IN ORIGINAL CONTAINER) AT THE COOK LINE. OBSERVED SQUEEZE BOTTLES OF OILS ALSO UNLABELED.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. PLEASE ENSURE ALL CONTAINERS/BOTTLES ARE LABELED.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: OBSERVED VARIOUS FOOD ITEMS AND/OR BEVERAGES STORED ON THE FLOOR IN WALK-IN COOLER, WALK-IN FREEZER, KITCHEN, AND BAR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PIC UNDERSTANDS ALL FOOD ITEMS SHOULD BE ELEVATED 6 INCHES OFF THE GROUND TO PREVENT CONTAMINATION AND ALLOW FOR EASY CLEANING.

violations.title: Hair Restraints
violations.observation: Employees observed working in the food service area without proper hair restraints.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wear hair restraints such as hats, visors, hair nets or beard nets to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service items. This section does not apply to food employees such as counter staff who ONLY serve beverages and wrapped or packaged foods, hostesses, and wait staff. PIC UNDERSTANDS ALL STAFF THAT HANDLE FOOD SHOULD WEAR A HAIR RESTRAINT. PLEASE ENSURE CORRECTION BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Laundered
violations.observation: Wiping cloths improperly stored between use, not in chemical sanitizing solution, in the following locations: THROUGHOUT BACK KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Cloths in use for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces shall be laundered daily. PLEASE ENSURE IN-USE WIPING CLOTHS ARE STORED IN SOLUTION WHEN NOT IN USE OR LAUNDERED WHEN DIRTY.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: OBSERVED A KNIFE BETWEEN PREP-TOP COOLER, CUPS WITHOUT HANDLES IN VARIOUS BULK FOOD ITEMS, AND SCOOPS WITHOUT THE HANDLE UP IN ICE MACHINE AND OTHER BULK FOOD ITEMS. OBSERVED UTENSILS IN STAGNANT WATER FOR RICE.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EHS DISCUSSED PROPER UTENSIL STORAGE WITH PIC. PLEASE ENUSRE CONTINUED CORRECTION.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: CHICKEN BASE , OYSTER SAUCES, BEAN SAUCE, AND HOISIN SAUCE manufacturer containers were observed reused for the storage of VARIOUS FOOD ITEMS.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. PIC UNDERSTANDS REUSE OF THESE CONTAINERS IS NOT PERMITTED AS THEY ARE NOT DURABLE AND NOT MEANT TO BE WASHED, RINSED, AND SANITIZED REPEATEDLY. PLEASE DISCONTINUE USE BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. OBSERVED Y-SPLITTER INSTALLED AT MOP SINK.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. PLEASE ENSURE APPROVED SPLITTER IS ORDERED BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: No Certified Food Manager on site at start of inspection. It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination.
violations.corrective_action: Certified Food Manager arrived on site at time of inspection.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: No paper towels observed at any of the hand sinks.
violations.corrective_action: CFM provided paper towels. Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 70F, No More than 2 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours: stir fry tofu observed at 75F on counter. Tofu was prepared about 4hrs. Prior.
violations.corrective_action: Tofu was discarded. Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: chicken, pork/veg samosa, beef and chicken on counter observed at 78, 75, 74, and 79F respectively. Pooled eggs on cart observed at room temperature.
violations.corrective_action: Foods were relocated to walk-in for rapid cooling. Do not store foods at ambient temperature/DANGER ZONE. Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food observed stored on the floor in the walk-in and walk-in freezer.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Improper backflow prevention device observed at mop sink. The system is under constant pressure.
violations.corrective_action: Pressure Bleed Dual Valve was ordered. Provide a backflow prevention device at the mop sink that is designed for a system under constant pressure (picture provided) or disconnect the T-valve. A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Ventilation Hood, Adequate
violations.observation: No exhaust hood observed above the Zojirushi grill.
violations.corrective_action: Remove grill and do not use. All equipment must be approved for use. Ventilation hood systems and devices shall operate properly and be sufficient in number and capacity to prevent grease or condensation from collecting on walls and ceilings.
